title: #14 - Hans Darry
content:
#14 - Hans Darry

Chapter 14 Hansdary

This posture is a bit awkward, but Arthur knows he should win.

Taking advantage of Dylan's fall, he used his right hand to push away Dylan's sword, then turned over and rode on Dylan's body.

He punched Dylan with both fists.

Under the gaze of dozens of people who were originally applauding, Arthur threw seven or eight punches.

Seven or eight punches with sincerity and without any discount.

Poor Dylan, it was the first time in his life that he was beaten so stupidly.

"Well~, I surrender, I surrender." Although his eyes were swollen and his mouth was bruised, he still insisted on sending a surrender signal.

Otherwise, he might really be beaten to death.

The referee immediately ran over and pulled Arthur away to prevent him from continuing to attack.

After making sure that Dylan was still alive, the officer announced:

"Lord Arthur Bracken won."

A few people, represented by Ma Ke, stood up and applauded Arthur, while the rest continued to greet Dylan's mother.

All kinds of dirty words came out one after another. After all, Arthur's two victories made many people lose a lot of money.

When Dylan was carried out, more than one person spit at him.

Although Arthur was also the key to their loss of money, no one was stupid enough to offend someone who could beat Aegor and Dylan.

Many people began to think that most people present could not beat Arthur.

If nothing unexpected happens, after today, the name Arthur Bracken will spread all over the south bank of the Red Fork River.

A newly rising warrior.

Looking at Dylan who was beaten so hard that he couldn't stand and needed to be carried out, Khalil blushed a little, after all, it was his knight who lost.

The idea of taking Dylan Weishui as his own sworn knight disappeared.

Hendry's face was a little gloomy, and I don't know what he was thinking.

Then, the acting mayor of Stonehedge City stood up and announced that the third match was about to begin.

"The knight I designated is..." He looked around, as if looking for a target.

Forty or fifty noble knights also followed his gaze, wondering who would be chosen.

Arthur walked to the wooden fence and asked the servant for a glass of wine.

After two fights, he was sweating all over and had two small holes poked in his body. He urgently needed wine to relieve his thirst and relax his tense nerves.

"Knight Hans Darry." Hendry announced his favorite candidate.

"What, it's him, the man who beat Blackfish!"

"Is he the cousin of William Darry, the coach of the Golden Robes?"

"Yes, it's him, and he's also the cousin of Viscount Raymond Darry."

The audience whispered, and no one expected that Hendry would send such a long-established figure.

Raymond Darry Arthur knew, the mayor of Darry City, a nobleman on the south bank of the Trident River.

Blackfish also knew that Brynden Tully, Edmure's uncle, was a famous knight in the riverlands.

He should be in the Eyrie in the Vale accompanying his niece Lysa Arryn.

The other two names sounded familiar to him, but he couldn't remember the corresponding characters.

As for the gold cloaks, the law enforcement team of King's Landing, there should be 1,200 people now.

He took the wine glass handed over by the servant and took the opportunity to ask: "Is William Darry the current coach of King's Landing?"

The servant looked at him in astonishment and whispered: "Of course not, you don't even know him?"

Arthur was very curious, "Who is he?"

The servant looked around, and then said mysteriously: "The coach of the gold cloaks in King's Landing during the Mad King's period, his swordsmanship was quite good. It is said that William Darry led the sleeping dragon Viserys to break out of the heavy siege of Dragonstone and headed for the continent of Essos."

"What about Hans Darry?"

The servant was not so shy about Arthur's new opponent, and said openly: "It is this Darry's cousin, who is also famous for his strong martial arts in the Riverlands and King's Landing."

Arthur nodded, indicating that he knew.

The servant waited for a few breaths, and saw that Arthur did not reward a few copper coins or wait to take away the cup, and turned to leave.

Darry Castle is near the Kingsroad on the south bank of the Trident. Like Harrenhal, it is an important place in the "capital region". The nobles there often like to interact with the nobles of King's Landing and the Crown.

In fact, from the establishment of the Targaryen Dynasty to Robert Baratheon's enthronement, the relationship between the Iron Throne and Harrenhal has always been better than that of the Tully family guarding the river.

The Doublebu family along the Red Fork River, the Vance and Piper families in the south, and the Tully family further west are a social circle that cannot be integrated into the circle in the east.

Therefore, it is normal for the original owner not to know Hans Darry.

Seeing the audience exclaiming, this Hans Darry is very powerful.

Arthur felt a little pressure.

Hendry heard the whispers of the audience and felt very satisfied.

"I didn't expect that you, Hendry, actually recruited a famous knight like Hans." Ma Ke seemed very excited.

Compared with normal noble children, he has a love for martial arts that exceeds that of ordinary people.

Khalil was also shocked. "Hans is a man who can tie with Blackfish. Isn't it too much of a bully to use him against Arthur?"

Hendry enjoyed the surprised attitude of his two companions of similar status.

Compared to the usual appearance of the two men who had seen everything, the scene in front of him made him feel a little complacent.

"Don't bully me. My distant cousin can beat the two knights you designated. He is a first-class master, right? Mr. Hans is the right one."

After Hendry finished speaking, he didn't wait for the two to express their opinions. He pretended to be generous and said to Arthur:

"Cousin, do you need to change into a suitable armor? Yours looks a bit useless."

Arthur was just looking forward to it, "It's better to find a mask or something."

"Take him to change." Hendry waved to the servant and blinked quickly.

The servant understood what his master meant and knew that he was asking him to find an ordinary chain mail.

So, Arthur followed Hendry's servant to change armor, and the knowledgeable nobles had already begun to spread Hans Darry's achievements and discussed the next duel.

"It seems that Arthur is doomed to lose this time."

"That's right, Hendry didn't even think about sending troops to mediate for his relatives."

"If Arthur can beat Hans, wouldn't he become famous in one battle?"

"Don't say such daydreaming words, if Arthur Bracken can win this battle, I will lick your asshole."

"It's a deal, I guess I'm going to have a double happiness."

In the armory of Stonehedge City, Arthur looked at the set of chain mail selected by the servant and asked, "Is there no better one?"

"You are tall, this is the only one you can wear."

Arthur glanced at the servant suspiciously, guessed that this was Hendry's order, and stopped making things difficult for him, and began to sit on the chair to change.

At the same time, he summoned a blue light curtain with his mind.

Every time he swung his sword and chopped, it was three points of experience, plus fighting also gave a little experience, so he should be able to upgrade to level three at this time.

After adding agility to the attribute points, iron bones to the skill points, and two-handed weapons to the weapon points, his data is as follows:

[Baron: Arthur Bracken]

[Level: 3]

[Experience: 1233/2200]

[Strength: 16]

[Agility: 11]

[Intelligence: 7]

[Charm: 9]

[Skills: Iron bones 4, strong attack 7, strong throw 1, strong bow 1, weapon mastery 2, shield defense 0, running 0, riding 3, horse archery 0, looting 0, coaching 0, tracking 0, tactics 1, guide 0, reconnaissance 0, healing 0, surgery 0, first aid 0, engineering 0, persuasion 1, prisoner management 0, command 3, trading 0]

[Weapon proficiency: one-handed weapon 74, two-handed weapon 105, long pole weapon 77, bow 31, crossbow 31, throwing 31]

He is a little confident of defeating Hans Darry.
